shortcode.shortcode_text:
[section heading="DOWNLOAD APP. REGISTER. DRIVE."]
[grid]

[column]
With SIXT share, we offer you a variety of mobility services to get from A to B. Simply open the SIXT app on your smartphone and quickly book a car in Germany or the Netherlands. Electric mopeds are available in Spain, France and Germany. Bikes are bookable in the selected cities in Germany. Choose an available vehicle from the app at any time, day or night. To end the rental, simply park in the business area and lock the vehicle using the app. 

[_cta:Register & Get 10€*](https://sixt.go.link/share?adj_t=f1ztwl6&adj_engagement_type=fallback_click&adj_deep_link=sixt%3A%2F%2Fwww.sixt.com%2Fshare&adj_campaign=us&adj_adgroup=sixtshare&adj_creative=home&adj_fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sixt.com%2Fshare%2Fregistration%2F&adj_redirect_macos=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sixt.com%2Fshare%2Fregistration%2F)

[section heading="Frequently asked Questions" theme="prime"]

# WHERE IS SIXT SHARE AVAILABLE?
You can find SIXT share in Germany, as well as in the Netherlands, France, Spain, Italy and Belgium. Find out where you can find us on the respective country pages or directly in the SIXT app. You only have to register once and can use all of SIXT services, no matter where you are. 

- [Belgium](https://www.sixt.com/share/belgium/)
- [France](https://www.sixt.com/share/france/)
- [Germany](https://www.sixt.com/share/germany/)
- [Italy](https://www.sixt.com/share/italy/)
- [Netherlands](https://www.sixt.com/share/netherlands/)
- [Spain](https://www.sixt.com/share/spain/)
[grid]
[column]
[accordion]
# What is SIXT share?
SIXT share is a mobility service that offers a flexible mobility services: from bikes, mopeds, scooters to shared cars. You can book shared car from a minute up to 7 days.  Simply book a vehicle in the business area with your smartphone, open it and drive off. All vehicles can be found in the SIXT app.

# How does SIXT share work?
To use SIXT share, you always need the latest version of the SIXT app. There you can see all available vehicles in the business area. You can reserve these for up to 15 minutes free of charge via the app and drive off straight away. You can end the rental within the SIXT share business area for free or at one of our 500 SIXT stations across Germany for a fee.
[/accordion]
[/column]
[/grid]
[/section]
